training_1996.readout: No evidence for the hypothesized minute-vs-five-minute mismatch in the original 1996 arrays. Image time coordinates inferred from whole-month frame counts, not supplied as explicit per-frame timestamps.
training_1996.unresolved: The published inference checkpoint's exact training scripts, run logs and data provenance have not been independently proven. Public train.py imports models.unet_v1, not present in tracked model tree at the time of audit.

prior_2001_2005_2009_synthetic.boundary: Synthetic OVATION targets are not independent SSUSI measurements. Group RMSE changes can reflect signal amplitude, mask composition, and target distribution; they are not causal storm effects.

existing_2005_01_real_ssusi.note: Original 12-acquisition real-satellite benchmark has NO strict Kp>5 evaluation. Differences between these nonrandom weather strata should be treated descriptively.

unused_real_ssusi_candidate_catalog.essential_limit: At most one EDR per selected date; distinct dates do not establish distinct storm intervals or statistical independence, and no SSUSI native support or high-Kp reconstruction accuracy has yet been computed.

workflow_decision: No retraining solely based on cadence audit. Proceed with (1) source/checkpoint provenance fingerprint (2) preparation of 6+6 new Kp-stratified EDRs (3) native support & UTC preflight (4) only then real withheld SSUSI inference and case-level evaluation.
reviewer_status: R2-4, R2-8 and R3-1 remain OPEN until new high-Kp observation metrics, provenance review and manuscript update. No English reviewer Responses yet.
